input.universe: Fixed n vertices, IDs [0,n), n may be zero

output.merge: True iff two components were joined
output.representative: An implementation representative, not a stable semantic label
output.partition: Exact; initially each vertex is separate

constraints.errors: out_of_range for invalid IDs; length_error for excessive n; allocation may throw
constraints.mutation: All nontrivial queries may compress paths
constraints.copy: A full value copy costs O(n); it is not a checkpoint API
constraints.threading: Use external synchronization; queries also mutate

complexity.operations: O(alpha(n)) amortized across a sequence; O(log(n+1)) individual worst case
complexity.space: 4n logical payload bytes, plus vector capacity/header; O(1) stack

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Random label-partition oracle; boundary IDs; size/count; redundant unions

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
provenance.license: Project distribution license not yet selected
